scope_note: Complete password reset flow — one-time link valid 60 min, single-use, invalidates all refresh tokens on success
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/admin/auth/password/forgot enqueues reset email (202, no user enumeration)
POST /api/admin/auth/password/reset validates token, hashes new password, invalidates token
Token is single-use — second use returns 410 Gone
Successful reset invalidates all existing refresh tokens via passwordChangedAt timestamp check
pnpm typecheck, lint, and vitest exit 0
